summary: Platinum Analytics Cayman Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on September 21, 2026, the Nasdaq Hearings Panel denied its request to reinstate trading and determined to delist its securities under Listing Rule IM-5101-4, citing trading activity indicative of potential manipulation and insufficient liquidity; the Panel rejected Staff's advisor and CEO-residence arguments. Trading was suspended September 23, 2026. The Company intends to seek review by the Nasdaq Listing and Hearing Review Council under Rule 5820, which will not stay suspension or delisting. Watch for the review outcome, potential OTC transition and liquidity/arb risks.
